description_en: Retrieves the SQL details of an SQL review ticket
description_zh: 获取SQL审核工单的SQL详情结果
name: ListSQLReviewOriginSQL

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SQL review ticket. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/257777.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh: SQL审核工单号。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/257777.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: order_id

fields.help_en:
The check result. Valid values:
new: waiting for analysis
unknown: parsing exception
check_not_pass: check failed
check_pass: check passed
force_pass: manually approved
force_not_pass: manually rejected
fields.help_zh:
检测结果。取值及说明如下：
new：等待分析。
unknown：解析异常。
check_not_pass：检测不通过。
check_pass：检测通过。
force_pass：人工通过。
force_not_pass：人工不通过
fields.name: check_status_result

fields.help_en: The ID of the reviewed file
fields.name: file_id

fields.help_en: The number of the page to return
fields.name: page_number

fields.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
fields.name: page_size

fields.help_en:
The SQL review optimization suggestions. Valid values:
MUST_IMPROVE: must be improved
POTENTIAL_ISSUE: potential issue
SUGGEST_IMPROVE: suggested improvement
USE_DMS_TOOLKIT: use lock-free structure change
USE_DMS_DML_UNLOCK: use lock-free data change
TABLE_INDEX_SUGGEST: index recommendation
fields.help_zh:
SQL审核优化建议。取值如下：
MUST_IMPROVE：必须改进。
POTENTIAL_ISSUE：潜在问题。
SUGGEST_IMPROVE：建议改进。
USE_DMS_TOOLKIT：使用无锁结构变更。
USE_DMS_DML_UNLOCK：使用无锁数据变更。
TABLE_INDEX_SUGGEST：索引推荐
fields.name: sql_review_result

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: tid

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the API call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用API失败时，返回的错误信息

OriginSQLList.description_en: The list of parsed SQL statements

items.description_en: The details of a single SQL statement

CheckStatus.description_en:
The check result. Valid values:
new: waiting for analysis
unknown: parsing exception
check_not_pass: check failed
check_pass: check passed
force_pass: manually approved
force_not_pass: manually rejected
CheckStatus.description_zh:
检测结果。返回值及说明如下：
new：等待分析。
unknown：解析异常。
check_not_pass：检测不通过。
check_pass：检测通过。
force_pass：人工通过。
force_not_pass：人工不通过

CheckedTime.description_en: The time when the SQL statement was checked

ReviewSummary.description_en:
The statistics on SQL review optimization suggestions (JSON character string). Valid values:
MUST_IMPROVE: must be improved
POTENTIAL_ISSUE: potential issue
SUGGEST_IMPROVE: suggested improvement
USEDMSTOOLKIT: use lock-free structure change
USEDMSDML_UNLOCK: use lock-free data change
TABLEINDEXSUGGEST: index recommendation
ReviewSummary.description_zh:
SQL审核优化建议的统计信息（JSON字符串）。返回值及说明如下：
MUST_IMPROVE：必须改进。
POTENTIAL_ISSUE：潜在问题。
SUGGEST_IMPROVE：建议改进。
USEDMSTOOLKIT：使用无锁结构变更。
USEDMSDML_UNLOCK：使用无锁数据变更。
TABLEINDEXSUGGEST：索引推荐

SQLContent.description_en: The SQL content in the file

SQLId.description_en: The ID of the SQL statement

SQLName.description_en: The name of the SQL statement

SQLReviewQueryKey.description_en: The key used to query the information about SQL review optimization suggestions. You can call the [GetSQLReviewOptimizeDetail]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465919.html） operation based on this key to obtain the details
SQLReviewQueryKey.description_zh: 查询SQL审核优化建议信息的Key。根据此Key调用[GetSQLReviewOptimizeDetail]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465919.html）接口获取详情

SqlHash.description_en: The value obtained by applying the MD5 hash algorithm to the SQL content
SqlHash.description_zh: 对SQL内容进行MD5散列算法后得到的值

StatusDesc.description_en: The description of the check result

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。返回值及说明如下：

true：请求成功。
false：请求失败

TotalCount.description_en: The number of SQL statements contained in the file
